I can't give you a full week summary yet. Your Google account isn't connected, so the local database has almost no sleep data for last week.

**What's stored for Monday, Oct 26 through Sunday, Nov 1:**
- One sleep record, dated Sunday, Nov 1: about 420 minutes (7 hours) asleep, from 11:00 PM on Oct 31 to 7:00 AM on Nov 1 (New York time).
- The other six days have no sleep records. That means no data was imported, not that you recorded zero sleep. Missing days aren't zeros.
- The record's parser is labeled "eval-synthetic," so it may be test data rather than your actual Google Health export. Please check that before relying on it.

**How overnight dates work:** A sleep session is filed under the calendar date you woke up, not the date you went to bed. Last night's sleep (Oct 31 at 11 PM to Nov 1 at 7 AM) counts toward Sunday, Nov 1. Going to bed Sunday night and waking Monday would count toward Monday. So a "Monday through Sunday" summary includes the sleep that ended on each of those mornings, and the night of Sunday Oct 25 to Monday Oct 26 falls under Monday.

**To get the full week:** I can connect your Google account. This opens a browser window for you to sign in and approve read-only access, then I'll import sleep data for the week. Should I go ahead? Alternatively, you can upload a Google Takeout export and I'll import it from there. Note that while Google's consent screen is in testing mode, the login expires after 7 days, so you may need to reconnect later.
